```python
# Import required modules
import PyChrono as pc
import numpy as np

# Initialize simulation
sim = pc.Simulation(pc.get_default_device(), pc.SimulationSetup(
    time_step=0.001,
    num_steps=1000,
    visualization=True,
    visualization_window="pychrono",
    enable Irrlicht=True,
    camera=pc.Camera(
        position=[5, 5, 5],
        look_at=[0, 0, 0],
        up=[0, 1, 0],
    ),
))

# Create ground
ground = pc.createGround(
    position=[0, 0, 0],
    size=[50, 50, 5],
    properties=pc.GroundProperties(
        friction=10,
        normal_force=1000,
    ),
)

# Create mass
mass = pc.createSphere(
    radius=0.5,
    mass=1,
    position=[0, 0, 0],
    shape=pc.Shape.SPHERE,
    material=pc.Material(
        color=[1, 1, 1],
        specularity=0.5,
        emissivity=0.8,
    ),
)

# Create spring
spring = pc.createRod(
    length=2,
    cross_section=0.1,
    material=pc.Material(
        color=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
        specularity=0.5,
        emissivity=0.8,
    ),
)

# Create damper
damper = pc.createDamper(
    damping=0.5,
    position=[0, 0, 0],
)

# Create link with TSDA connection
link = pc.createLink(
    name="Mass-Spring-Damper",
    body1=ground,
    body2=mass,
    anchor1=[0, 0, 0],
    anchor2=[0, 0, 0],
    type=pc.LinkType.TSDA,
    properties=pc.LinkProperties(
        spring_constant=1000,
        damper_damping=0.5,
        spring_force=0,
        damper_force=0,
    ),
)

# Add lighting
light = pc.createLight(
    position=[5, 5, 5],
    direction=[-1, -1, -1],
    color=[1, 1, 1],
    intensity=1,
    attenuation=1000,
)

# Set visualization properties
sim.setVisualizationProperties(
    ground_properties=pc.VisualProperties(
        color=[1, 1, 1],
        wireframe=False,
        visible=True,
    ),
    mass_properties=pc.VisualProperties(
        color=[1, 1, 1],
        wireframe=False,
        visible=True,
    ),
    spring_properties=pc.VisualProperties(
        color=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
        wireframe=False,
        visible=True,
    ),
    link_properties=pc.VisualProperties(
        color=[0, 0, 0],
        wireframe=False,
        visible=True,
    ),
)

# Run simulation
sim.run()
```

import pychrono as chrono

class MySpringForce(chrono.ForceFunctor):
    def __init__(self, spring_coef, damping_coef):
        super().__init__()
        self.spring_coef = spring_coef
        self.damping_coef = damping_coef

    def Evaluate(self, body1, body2, frame1, frame2, time):
        # Calculate displacement vector
        pos1 = body1.GetPos(frame1)
        pos2 = body2.GetPos(frame2)
        displacement = pos2 - pos1

        # Calculate velocity vector
        vel1 = body1.GetVelocity(frame1)
        vel2 = body2.GetVelocity(frame2)
        relative_velocity = vel2 - vel1

        # Spring force calculation
        spring_force = self.spring_coef * (displacement.Length() - rest_length)
        spring_force = spring_force * displacement.Normalize()

        # Damping force calculation
        damping_force = -self.damping_coef * relative_velocity.Length()
        damping_force = damping_force * relative_velocity.Normalize()

        # Combine forces
        total_force = spring_force + damping_force

        return total_force

sph_1 = chrono.ChVisualShapeSphere(0.1)
ground.AddVisualShape(sph_1, chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(-1, 0, 0)))

sph_2 = chrono.ChVisualShapeSphere(0.1)
ground.AddVisualShape(sph_2, chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(1, 0, 0)))

# Body 1 setup
body_1 = chrono.ChBody()
sys.AddBody(body_1)
body_1.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(-1, -3, 0))
body_1.SetFixed(False)
body_1.EnableCollision(False)
body_1.SetMass(1)
body_1.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVector3d(1, 1, 1))

# Visualization for body_1
box_1 = chrono.ChVisualShapeBox(1, 1, 1)
box_1.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.6, 0, 0))
body_1.AddVisualShape(box_1)

# Body 2 setup (mirror of body_1)
body_2 = chrono.ChBody()
sys.AddBody(body_2)
body_2.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(1, -3, 0))
body_2.SetFixed(False)
body_2.EnableCollision(False)
body_2.SetMass(1)
body_2.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVector3d(1, 1, 1))

# Visualization for body_2
box_2 = chrono.ChVisualShapeBox(1, 1, 1)
box_2.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.6, 0, 0))
body_2.AddVisualShape(box_2)

sphere_2 = chrono.ChVisualShapeSphere(0.1)
body_2.AddVisualShape(sphere_2)

# Create spring_1 with direct coefficients
spring_1 = chrono.ChLinkTSDA()
spring_1.Initialize(body_1, ground, True, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(-1, 0, 0))
spring_1.SetRestLength(rest_length)
spring_1.SetSpringCoefficient(spring_coef)
spring_1.SetDampingCoefficient(damping_coef)
sys.AddLink(spring_1)

# Create spring_2 with custom force functor
spring_2 = chrono.ChLinkTSDA()
spring_2.Initialize(body_2, ground, True, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(-1, 0, 0))
spring_2.SetForceFunctor(MySpringForce(spring_coef, damping_coef))
sys.AddLink(spring_2)

# Visualization setup
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(sys)
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetWindowTitle('ChLinkTSDA demo with Custom Force Functor')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 6))
vis.AddTypicalLights()

while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()
    sys.DoStepDynamics(1e-3)

   - A second spring (`spring_2`) was created for `body_2`, using the custom `MySpringForce` functor to calculate forces.
